title: Silver Flame
note: Canonical sheet for track 877ddf025543501dbf4c (gothic hymn, 2:00 take). Directed cold from the profile: slow, sparse, dark spectrum. Style: the sanctum pack — one candle in the dark, born in the intro, guttering on 'when the final candle darkens' and dying after the final line, exactly as the lyric scripts. Didot display over Baskerville, near-monochrome bone and silver with one candle-gold verse, motion 0.2, no inversions, no crack. Devices only where the words earn them: 'Leave behind your name' lets go of its words; the candle lines drive the flame.

lines.text: O silver flame, remain unseen
Beneath the storm, beneath the dream
The bells are still in the hollow tower
The ivy sleeps on the nameless door
We bear no crown, we speak no hour
We cross where shadows cross before
A single candle bends in warning
A blackened mirror holds the sky
The earth is cold with ancient mourning
The stars have closed their many eyes
Enter without footsteps
Leave behind your name
What waits below remembers
Neither mercy nor blame
Carry me down through the veil of night
Where the roots drink deep from the buried light
Lay my sorrow in the circle
Drawn till the old dark breaks into solemn dawn
O silent ones, receive this breath
Guard the gate between sleep and death
Carry me down where the pale winds moan
To the hour beneath the stone
The piano falls like winter water
One note upon the chapel floor
A choir of dust, a vanished daughter
Sings from behind the sealed-up door
No hand is raised, no vow is spoken
Yet every heart becomes aflame
The thread of time is cut and broken
And something answers without a name
The circle is not a prison
The silence is not peace
When the final candle darkens
The listening will cease
Carry me down through the veil of night
Where the roots drink deep from the buried light
Lay my sorrow in the circle drawn till the old dark breaks into dawn
